name: 123. Bedrock invoke thinking token breakdown (#7649)
description: Regression for #7649. The /bedrock/model/{id}/invoke and /invoke-with-response-stream routes accept an Anthropic-native InvokeModel body but were served by Converse upstream, and AWS Converse TokenUsage has no thinking-token breakdown (verified live 2026-09-28: same Sonnet 5 adaptive-thinking request returns {inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, cache*} on Converse and usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens on InvokeModel). Two layers dropped the count: the provider never had it, and the invoke egress (toBedrockInvokeAnthropicResponse / toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes) had no output_tokens_details field even when Bifrost did. Fix: the invoke ingress marks the context, responsesUsesAnthropicInvokePath routes marked Anthropic-family thinking requests to InvokeModel upstream (where the shared anthropic handlers already map thinking_tokens -> ReasoningTokens), and the egress writes output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens. Case 1 pins the non-streaming route, case 2 the stream's message_delta, case 3 guards that thinking-disabled requests stay on Converse with no output_tokens_details.

item.name: Bedrock invoke: adaptive thinking token breakdown reaches usage.output_tokens_details (Sonnet 5) - #7649

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
// #7649: AWS Converse TokenUsage has no thinking-token breakdown, so a /bedrock/.../invoke request
// translated to Converse upstream came back with usage.output_tokens_details absent even though
// InvokeModel returns output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens for the same call. Red before the fix
// (no output_tokens_details on the response), green after (InvokeModel upstream + egress carries it).
pm.test('Bedrock invoke adaptive thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
// Adaptive thinking lets the model skip thinking on easy inputs (Anthropic docs); Sonnet 5 does so on most
// runs of this prompt, and Bifrost rewrites thinking:enabled to adaptive for 4.7+ models, so a thinking block
// cannot be required here. What is deterministic: InvokeModel always returns the breakdown (thinking_tokens: 0
// when it skipped) and Bifrost must forward it either way - a zero used to be dropped.
pm.test('Bedrock invoke adaptive thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens matches the thinking block', function () {
var blocks = Array.isArray(body.content) ? body.content : [];
var thinking = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'thinking'; });
var usage = body.usage || {};
pm.expect(usage.output_tokens, 'usage.output_tokens missing: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.a('number');
var details = usage.output_tokens_details;
pm.expect(details, 'usage.output_tokens_details dropped by the Bedrock provider (thinking token breakdown lost): ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be a number: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens is a subset of output_tokens, never additive: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.at.most(usage.output_tokens);
if (thinking.length > 0) {
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be > 0 when a thinking block was produced: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.above(0);
} else {
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be 0 when adaptive thinking produced no thinking block: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.eql(0);

item.name: Bedrock invoke-with-response-stream: adaptive thinking token breakdown on message_delta (Sonnet 5) - #7649

exec: var rawText = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('Bedrock invoke-with-response-stream adaptive thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + rawText.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('Bedrock invoke-with-response-stream adaptive thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: message_delta.usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens present', function () {
var b64Matches = rawText.match(/"bytes":"([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)"/g) || [];
pm.expect(b64Matches.length, 'expected at least one invoke-stream chunk event: ' + rawText.slice(0, 300)).to.be.above(0);
var events = b64Matches.map(function (m) {
try { return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(b64, 'base64').toString('utf8')); } catch (e) { return null; }
}).filter(function (e) { return e; });
var thinkingStarts = events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'content_block_start' && e.content_block && e.content_block.type === 'thinking'; });
var deltas = events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'message_delta' && e.usage; });
pm.expect(deltas.length, 'expected a message_delta event carrying usage: ' + JSON.stringify(events).slice(0, 500)).to.be.above(0);
var usage = deltas[deltas.length - 1].usage;
pm.expect(usage.output_tokens, 'message_delta.usage.output_tokens missing: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.a('number');
var details = usage.output_tokens_details;
pm.expect(details, 'message_delta.usage.output_tokens_details dropped (thinking token breakdown lost): ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be a number: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.a('number');
// Adaptive thinking may skip thinking entirely; the breakdown must still stream, as 0 (see the sibling case).
if (thinkingStarts.length > 0) {
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be > 0 when a thinking block streamed: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.above(0);
} else {
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens must be 0 when adaptive thinking streamed no thinking block: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.eql(0);
pm.expect(details.thinking_tokens, 'thinking_tokens is a subset of output_tokens: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.at.most(usage.output_tokens);

item.name: Bedrock invoke: thinking disabled keeps Converse usage shape, no output_tokens_details (Sonnet 5) - #7649

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
// #7649 guard: only thinking requests move to InvokeModel upstream. With thinking disabled the
// request stays on Converse and the response must not grow an output_tokens_details object,
// matching what Anthropic returns for a non-thinking response.
pm.test('Bedrock invoke thinking disabled no thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('Bedrock invoke thinking disabled no thinking token breakdown (Sonnet 5) - #7649: no thinking block and no output_tokens_details', function () {
var blocks = Array.isArray(body.content) ? body.content : [];
pm.expect(blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'thinking'; }).length, 'thinking disabled must not produce a thinking block: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(0);
var usage = body.usage || {};
pm.expect(usage.output_tokens, 'usage.output_tokens missing: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(usage.output_tokens_details, 'non-thinking response must not carry output_tokens_details: ' + JSON.stringify(usage)).to.be.undefined;
